title: Plasma Metallurgy
description: Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.

puzzle.goal: Particles in a hot plasma share energy according to a thermal weight e^(−βE), with β = 1/(kB T), and a density of states proportional to √E for free motion in three dimensions. Write the mean energy per particle by differentiating the logarithm of the partition integral with respect to β.
puzzle.name: Equipartition of energy (from the partition function)
puzzle.form: - pd ( ln ( int ( 0 , ∞ , sqrt ( E ) * exp ( - β * E ) , E ) ) , β )
puzzle.ask: The integral is (√π/2)β^(−3/2), so the result is (3/2)kB T. Find the mean energy (eV) of a particle in the plasma below.
puzzle.method: Weighted averages of E follow from the logarithmic derivative of the normalising integral: d(ln Z)/dβ = −⟨E⟩.
